description: A black lacquered box on the bar, sold as a humidor to people who don't smoke. The lid lifts on a hinge you can't see. Inside, in foam cut to fit, is everything a man needs to be brilliant on schedule, each slot priced on a card in the lid. Take one and the foam is full again next time you look.

flags.vend_line: The lid lifts with a sigh of cool air and the card slot takes its due. You pick the vial out of its foam.

name: lacquered box
